## :material-brain: Training
URL: https://tyson-swetnam.github.io/awesome-fire-science/training.md

# :material-brain: Training

This comprehensive directory organizes wildland fire training resources by audience and career stage. From entry-level firefighter certifications to specialized smoke management courses, from tribal cultural burning programs to university doctoral research, these resources serve the full spectrum of fire science professionals and land managers.

## 1. :material-school-outline: Getting Started in Wildland Fire

For students, career changers, and entry-level firefighters beginning their journey in wildland fire.

??? Tip "NWCG Foundation Courses"

    [National Wildfire Coordination Group Courses](https://www.nwcg.gov/training/training-catalog){target=_blank} provide the foundation for wildland fire qualifications nationwide. Core courses include S-130 (Firefighter Training), S-190 (Introduction to Wildland Fire Behavior), and position-specific training for engine operators, crew bosses, and incident management teams.

??? Tip "Youth & Early Career Programs"

    [Student Conservation Association Wildland Fire Academy](https://thesca.org/sca-wildland-fire-academy){target=_blank} - 6-month paid positions ($650-$1,000/week) with full NWCG certification on Shasta-Trinity National Forest. Hands-on training preparing participants for federal fire careers.

    [California Conservation Corps](https://ccc.ca.gov/training/firefighting/){target=_blank} - Operates 26+ hand crews at 13 locations with monthly stipends potentially exceeding $32,000 first year. Entry-level wildland firefighting with year-round crew assignments.

    [Veterans Fire Corps](https://www.veteransfirecorps.org/){target=_blank} (Conservation Legacy/SCA/AmeriCorps) - 12-week to 6-month assignments with 94% of participants reporting the program prepared them for fire employment. Targeted toward veterans transitioning to civilian fire careers.

    [Clackamas Community College](https://www.clackamas.edu/academics/departments-programs/wildland-fire-management-aas){target=_blank} (Oregon) - Four certificate pathways certified by PNWCG and NWCG, instructors with 15-30 years experience, includes EMT certification.

    [Lane Community College](https://www.lanecc.edu/programs-academics/areas-study/science-natural-resources-math-and-engineering/wildland-fire-management){target=_blank} (Oregon) - Includes traditional cultural burning practices from Pacific Northwest Indigenous peoples alongside standard NWCG training.

    [Lake Superior College](https://www.lsc.edu/degrees/wildland-firefighting-certificate/){target=_blank} - One-year Wildland Firefighting Certificate preparing students for seasonal fire positions.

    [Minnesota North College](https://minnesotanorth.edu/programs/wildland-firefighting/){target=_blank} (formerly Itasca Community College) - Eight NWCG courses with partnerships across federal and state agencies, one of the strongest community college programs in the Midwest.

??? Tip "Federal Agency Entry Pathways"

    [USFS Wildland Fire Apprenticeship Program](https://www.fs.usda.gov/managing-land/fire/careers){target=_blank} - Department of Labor-accredited apprenticeships providing structured career pathways in the Forest Service.

    [USFWS Wildland Fire Apprenticeship](https://www.fws.gov/program/fire-management/get-involved){target=_blank} - Launched 2022, DOL-accredited program with 12-48 month pathways including details to helitack, hand crews, rappel crews, and fire use modules. First class included 28 apprentices.

    [BIA Pathways Internship Program](https://www.bia.gov/service/pathways){target=_blank} - Connects Native American and Alaska Native college students to paid fire management internships across BIA and tribal programs.

## 2. :octicons-organization-24: Federal Agency Training

For federal firefighters and resource specialists working across agencies.

??? Tip "Multi-Agency Coordination"

    [NAFRI Courses](https://www.nafri.gov/courses){target=_blank} - National Advanced Fire and Resource Institute provides advanced training for incident management teams and overhead positions.

    [National Interagency Prescribed Fire Training Center](https://talltimbers.org/fire-training/){target=_blank} - Established 2021 at Tall Timbers Research Station, providing multi-agency prescribed fire training with emphasis on southeastern fire ecology.

??? Tip "USFS Programs"

    [United States Forest Service Training](https://www.fs.usda.gov/managing-land/fire/training){target=_blank} - Comprehensive fire training programs for Forest Service personnel.

    [Interagency Fire Program Management Standard (IFPM)](https://www.fs.usda.gov/managing-land/ifpm){target=_blank} - Standardized fire program management across federal agencies.

    [Fire Ecology Curriculum (Southwestern Region)](https://www.fs.usda.gov/r03/educational/educators/fire-ecology-learning-lab){target=_blank} - Ecological foundations for fire management in southwestern ecosystems.

    [Smokejumper Rookie Training](https://www.fs.usda.gov/science-technology/fire/people/smokejumpers){target=_blank} - 5-week intensive program at bases in Missoula, McCall, Redding, and seven other locations. Requires 3-4 years fire experience (hotshot preferred), with specific fitness standards: 7 pull-ups, 45 sit-ups, 25 push-ups, 1.5-mile run under 11 minutes, and 110-lb pack test.

??? Tip "BLM Training"

    [BLM National Training Center](https://www.nifc.gov/about-us/our-partners/blm/training){target=_blank} - Phoenix-based facility offering distance learning through DOI Talent platform for BLM fire personnel nationwide.

    [Great Basin Training Unit](https://www.blm.gov/programs/fire/regional-info/nevada){target=_blank} - Delivers approximately 60 courses annually to over 1,000 personnel across the Great Basin region.

    [BLM Alaska Fire Service](https://fire.ak.blm.gov/){target=_blank} - Maintains the "Handy Dandy" firefighting field guide and coordinates Alaska-specific training addressing unique northern fire conditions.

    [BLM Idaho Boise Helitack](https://www.nifc.gov/about-us/our-partners/blm/blm-helitack-crews){target=_blank} - Operates the only DOI Type 1 helicopter (UH-60 Blackhawk), providing specialized aviation training opportunities.

??? Tip "National Park Service"

    [Wildland Fire Resource Advisor Course (N-9042)](https://www.nps.gov/orgs/1965/wildfire-training.htm){target=_blank} - Online course certifying 500-700+ students annually in providing resource protection advice during incidents.

    [Non-Fire Employee Surge Capacity Training](https://www.nps.gov/orgs/1965/wildfire-training.htm){target=_blank} - Trains rangers, interpreters, and other NPS staff to support fire operations during peak seasons.

??? Tip "US Fish & Wildlife Service"

    [USFWS Wildland Fire Apprenticeship](https://www.fws.gov/program/fire-management/get-involved){target=_blank} - DOL-accredited program launched 2022, with details to helitack, hand crews, and rappel operations. Note: USFWS applies 50% of all DOI prescribed fire acres.

??? Tip "Bureau of Indian Affairs"

    [Wildland Fire First Aid Program](https://www.nifc.gov/about-us/our-partners/bia/training){target=_blank} - Medical Incident Technician and Medical Incident Leadership training levels. Over 740 students from 50+ Indian Country fire crews have completed certified classes, representing approximately 60% of Indian Country's permanent fire workforce.

## 3. :material-map-marker-multiple: State & Regional Programs

For state and local firefighters and regional fire professionals.

??? Tip "California"

    [CAL FIRE Training Centers](https://www.fire.ca.gov/what-we-do/fire-protection/training-center){target=_blank} - Four facilities (Ione, Riverside, Atwater opening 2025, and future fourth facility) providing IFSAC/Pro Board certified training for state firefighters.

    [City College of San Francisco Fire Science](https://www.ccsf.edu/degrees-certificates/fire-science-technology){target=_blank} - Wildland fire academy with NWCG certification pathways.

    [Mt. San Antonio College Fire Technology](https://www.mtsac.edu/firetech/){target=_blank} - Community college wildland fire training program.

    [Reedley College Fire Technology](https://www.reedleycollege.edu/academics/guided-pathways/agriculture-nr-pathway/wildland-fire.html){target=_blank} - Wildland fire academy serving California's Central Valley.

??? Tip "Colorado"

    [CWFIMA (Colorado Wildland Fire and Incident Management Academy)](https://cwfima.org/){target=_blank} - Operating since 1994 with 900+ staff and students annually. Served as the model for academies in New York, Utah, Texas, and Arizona.

    [Front Range Community College Wildland Fire Certificate](https://www.frontrange.edu/programs-courses/program-list/forestry-wildlife-natural-resources.html){target=_blank} - One-semester Wildland Fire Certificate for rapid entry into fire careers.

??? Tip "Arizona"

    [AWIMA (Arizona Wildland Fire and Incident Management Academy)](https://azwildfireacademy.org/){target=_blank} - Offers 40+ course types annually addressing southwestern fire management needs.

    [Women in Wildland Fire](https://www.azwildfireacademy.org/womeninwildlandfire){target=_blank} - Immersive program supporting women pursuing wildland fire careers.

??? Tip "Washington"

    [Washington DNR Academies](https://dnr.wa.gov/wildfire-resources/fighting-fire/wildland-fire-academies){target=_blank} - No-cost interagency training meeting NWCG standards, including virtual instructor-led training October through April. Special initiative provides funded training specifically for tribal members.

??? Tip "Oregon"

    [Mid-Willamette Valley Interagency Fire School](https://www.saif.com/safety-and-health/topic/wildfire/mid-willamette-valley-fire-school.html){target=_blank} - Operating since 1997, providing interagency training for Oregon fire personnel.

    [State Certified Burn Manager Program](https://extension.oregonstate.edu/fire-program/certified-burn-manager){target=_blank} - Established per Senate Bill 762 (2021) with civil liability protection for certified practitioners. Two levels: pile burning, and pile and broadcast burning.

??? Tip "Nevada"

    [Nevada Division of Forestry Training](https://forestry.nv.gov/wildland-fire-management){target=_blank} - Trained 2,938 personnel in 2024 using 30 instructors through Rookie Academy and Engine Academy programs.

??? Tip "Texas"

    [Texas A&M Forest Service Academies](https://ticc.tamu.edu/training/){target=_blank}:

    - **East Texas Academy** - May, Lufkin area, 26th annual in 2025
    - **Capital Area Academy** - October, Camp Swift, 27th annual in 2025

    Both provide comprehensive interagency training for Texas fire personnel.

??? Tip "Florida"

    [Withlacoochee Training Center](https://www.fdacs.gov/Forest-Wildfire/Our-Forests/Florida-Forest-Service/Withlacoochee-Forestry-Center){target=_blank} - 5-6 week intensive Basic Firefighter Certification Training, prerequisite for Forest Ranger employment. Emphasizes Florida ecosystem fire behavior and wildland-urban interface operations.

??? Tip "Fire Science Exchange Network (JFSP)"

    The Joint Fire Science Program funds 15 regional exchanges providing webinars, workshops, and field tours:

    [Southern Fire Exchange](https://southernfireexchange.org/){target=_blank} - Covers 11 states, partnered with University of Florida and Tall Timbers Research Station.

    [California Fire Science Consortium](https://www.cafirescience.org/){target=_blank} - Weekly seminar series and California Forest Science Symposium connecting researchers with practitioners.

    [Northwest Fire Science Consortium](https://www.nwfirescience.org/){target=_blank} - California Forest Science Symposium partnerships.

    [Northern Rockies Fire Science Network](https://www.nrfirescience.org/){target=_blank} - Maintains archive of 400+ recorded webinars.

    [Southwest Fire Science Consortium](https://www.swfireconsortium.org/){target=_blank} - Serves Arizona, New Mexico, and neighboring regions.

    [Great Basin Fire Science Exchange](https://greatbasinfirescience.org/){target=_blank} - Nevada, Utah, and surrounding areas.

    [Great Plains Fire Science Exchange](https://gpfirescience.org/){target=_blank} - Plains states fire ecology and management.

    [Oak Woodlands and Forests Fire Consortium](https://oakfirescience.com/){target=_blank} - Oak ecosystem fire management.

    [Lake States Fire Science Consortium](http://lakestatesfiresci.net/){target=_blank} - Minnesota, Wisconsin, Michigan fire research translation.

Students complete Wildland Fire Field Camp with prescribed burn training in North Carolina and Florida.

Degree completion program accepting credit for prior fire certifications.

## 5. :material-certificate-outline: Professional Certifications

For practicing professionals seeking credentials and certifications.

??? Tip "State Certified Prescribed Burn Manager Programs"

    **Alabama** - 32-hour course, $50 fee, 5-year certification.

    [California (CA-RX) Burn Boss](https://www.fire.ca.gov/programs/resource-management/resource-protection-improvement/prescribed-fire/){target=_blank} - Burn Boss certification with 40-hour classroom training plus task book. 55 active certified as of December 2025.

    [Florida Certified Prescribed Burn Manager](https://www.fdacs.gov/Forest-Wildfire/Wildland-Fire/Florida-Prescribed-Burn){target=_blank} - 24-hour course ($175), approximately 1,800 certified practitioners statewide.

    [Georgia Certified Prescribed Burn Manager](https://gatrees.org/fire-prevention-suppression/prescribed-burn-certification/){target=_blank} - Written exam requiring 70% or higher, 2 years experience, 5 prescribed burns led.

    [Mississippi Certified Prescribed Burn Manager](https://www.mfc.ms.gov/prescribed-burning){target=_blank} - 1-day or 3-day options with 80% pass requirement.

    [Missouri Certified Burner](https://mdc.mo.gov/your-property/fire-management/prescribed-fire){target=_blank} - Online course ($25) through Missouri Department of Conservation, leads to Certified Burner status.

    [Oklahoma Prescribed Fire](https://extension.okstate.edu/programs/prescribed-fire/){target=_blank} - Oklahoma State University Extension self-paced course, 9 modules covering prescribed fire fundamentals.

    [Oregon Certified Burn Manager](https://extension.oregonstate.edu/fire-program/certified-burn-manager){target=_blank} - Two certification levels (pile burning; pile and broadcast burning), provides civil liability protection under state law.

    **Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Virginia, Texas** - Various state-specific requirements and durations.

    [Texas A&M AgriLife Extension Prescribed Burn Manager](https://agrilifeextension.tamu.edu/){target=_blank} - Certified and Insured Prescribed Burn Manager preparation program.

??? Tip "NWCG Specialized Qualifications"

    [Fire Behavior Analyst (FBAN)](https://www.nwcg.gov/positions/fire-behavior-analyst){target=_blank} - Requires S-490, S-491, and completed task book. Provides fire behavior analysis and forecasting on incidents.

    [Long Term Fire Analyst (LTAN)](https://www.nwcg.gov/positions/long-term-fire-analyst){target=_blank} - Requires satisfactory FBAN performance plus S-590. Provides extended fire behavior forecasting for complex incidents.

    [NRCS Technical Service Provider](https://www.nrcs.usda.gov/conservation-basics/conservation-by-state/technical-service-providers){target=_blank} - Prescribed Burning (Code 338) certification enables recommending burns as a conservation planning alternative for agricultural producers.

??? Tip "Fire Investigation Certifications"

    [IAAI-CFI](https://www.firearson.com/Certifications){target=_blank} (International Association of Arson Investigators Certified Fire Investigator) - Requires 5+ years experience, 400 hours documented training, Pro Board and FSAB accredited.

    [NAFI-CFEI](https://www.nafi.org/certification){target=_blank} (National Association of Fire Investigators Certified Fire and Explosion Investigator) - Oldest and most widely held fire investigation certification, based solely on NFPA 921.

    [CCAI-CFI](https://www.arson.org/){target=_blank} (California Conference of Arson Investigators Certified Fire Investigator) - Three levels (Technician, CFI, Master), requires 75 fires for origin determination and 75 for cause investigations.

??? Tip "Wildland-Urban Interface Certifications"

    [NFPA Certified Wildfire Mitigation Specialist](https://www.nfpa.org/education-and-research/certifications/wildfire-mitigation){target=_blank} - Demonstrates professional competence in wildfire hazard mitigation and WUI protection.

    [IBHS Wildfire Prepared Home](https://wildfireprepared.org/){target=_blank} - Free online learning with three designation levels (Base, Plus, Plus with Ventilation) available in California, Oregon, Nevada, and New Mexico.

    [International Code Council IWUIC Training](https://www.iccsafe.org/products-and-services/i-codes/wildland-urban-interface-wui/){target=_blank} - International Wildland-Urban Interface Code training, adopted statewide in California, Utah, Montana, Nevada, Pennsylvania, and Washington.

## 6. :material-leaf-maple: Prescribed Fire for Private Landowners

For private landowners, ranchers, and land managers implementing prescribed fire.

??? Tip "Prescribed Fire Councils (35 councils in 31 states)"

    [Coalition of Prescribed Fire Councils](https://www.prescribedfire.net/){target=_blank} - Umbrella organization supporting state and regional councils nationwide.

    **Florida Prescribed Fire Councils** - The oldest in the nation, with North Florida council established 1989. Multiple regional councils statewide.

    **Georgia, Texas, Washington, Illinois, Michigan, Idaho, Missouri, Oklahoma** - All have active councils providing landowner workshops, Learn and Burn events, and certification support.

    Councils provide networking, technical assistance, liability coverage information, and hands-on training opportunities for private landowners.

??? Tip "Extension Service Programs"

    [Oklahoma State University Extension Prescribed Fire](https://extension.okstate.edu/programs/prescribed-fire/){target=_blank} - Self-paced Introduction to Prescribed Fire with 9 modules covering planning, implementation, and safety.

    [Missouri Department of Conservation Prescribed Burning](https://mdc.mo.gov/your-property/fire-management/prescribed-fire){target=_blank} - Online Prescribed Burning for Land Managers course ($25), leads to Certified Burner status for landowners.

    [Texas A&M AgriLife Extension](https://agrilifeextension.tamu.edu/){target=_blank} - Certified and Insured Prescribed Burn Manager preparation supporting Texas landowners.

??? Tip "Wildlife Organization Programs"

    [Pheasants Forever/Quail Forever](https://www.pheasantsforever.org/Hunt/Prescribed-Fire.aspx){target=_blank} - Employs Prescribed Burn Coordinators in Minnesota, North Dakota, Illinois, and Texas who conduct landowner workshops and support Prescribed Burn Association formation.

    [National Wild Turkey Federation](https://www.nwtf.org/hunt/article/fire-management-wildlife-habitat){target=_blank} - Provides fire webinars, equipment grants for Prescribed Burn Associations, and NRCS partnership programs.

    [Audubon Canyon Ranch Fire Forward](https://egret.org/fire-forward){target=_blank} (California) - 11-month paid Prescribed Fire Apprentice position and Fire Forward Fellowship supporting cultural and ecological burning.

## 7. :material-leaf: Tribal & Indigenous Fire Programs

For tribal communities and Indigenous fire practitioners revitalizing traditional fire practices.

??? Tip "Indigenous Peoples Burning Network (IPBN)"

    [Indigenous Peoples Burning Network](https://firenetworks.org/ipbn/){target=_blank} - Founded 2015, administered by The Nature Conservancy. Supports 26+ tribes in revitalizing cultural fire practices through:

    - Community-based burning programs
    - Indigenous-led TREX events (including Yurok TREX)
    - Cultural Burning Program Builders Working Group
    - Annual network workshops connecting elders with youth
    - Support for Indigenous fire governance and traditional knowledge

??? Tip "Intertribal Timber Council"

    [Intertribal Timber Council](https://www.itcnet.org/){target=_blank} - Fire Subcommittee coordinates tribal fire workforce development and training.

    **Biennial Tribal Forestry and Wildland Fire Student Summit** - Brings together tribal students pursuing fire careers.

    **Truman D. Picard Scholarships** - Financial support for Native American and Alaska Native students in natural resources.

    **2023-2028 Workforce Development Strategic Plan** - Addresses tribal fire capacity building and career pathways.

??? Tip "BIA Training Programs"

    [Wildland Fire First Aid Program](https://www.nifc.gov/about-us/our-partners/bia/training){target=_blank} - Medical Incident Technician and Medical Incident Leadership training levels. Over 740 students from 50+ Indian Country fire crews, representing ~60% of permanent tribal fire workforce.

    [Pathways Internship Program](https://www.bia.gov/service/pathways){target=_blank} - Connects Native American and Alaska Native college students to paid fire management internships across BIA and tribal programs.

??? Tip "University Programs with Indigenous Focus"

    [Lane Community College Fire Science](https://www.lanecc.edu/programs-academics/areas-study/science-natural-resources-math-and-engineering/wildland-fire-management){target=_blank} - Includes Pacific Northwest Indigenous traditional cultural burning practices alongside standard NWCG training.

    [UBC Okanagan Wildland Fire Ecology](https://cpe.ok.ubc.ca/programs/wildland-fire-ecology-and-management/){target=_blank} - Micro-credential in Wildland Fire Ecology combining Indigenous and Western fire science perspectives.

??? Tip "Traditional Ecological Knowledge Resources"

    [:material-leaf: US NPS Overview of TEK](https://www.nps.gov/subjects/tek/description.htm){target=_blank} - National Park Service introduction to Traditional Ecological Knowledge in land management.

    [:material-leaf: Yale Environment 360 - Overview](https://e360.yale.edu/features/native-knowledge-what-ecologists-are-learning-from-indigenous-people){target=_blank} - What ecologists are learning from Indigenous people about fire and land stewardship.

    [Global Indigenous Data Alliance](https://www.gida-global.org/care){target=_blank} - CARE principles for Indigenous Data Governance (Collective benefit, Authority to control, Responsibility, Ethics).

## 8. :material-web: Online & Self-Paced Learning

For remote learners and busy professionals needing flexible training options.

??? Tip "MOOCs & University Online Courses"

    [University of Alaska Fairbanks Remote Sensing of Wildfires on edX](https://www.edx.org/learn/data-analysis/university-of-alaska-fairbanks-remote-sensing-of-wildfires){target=_blank} - 4-week self-paced course covering satellite imagery analysis, QGIS, and Google Earth Engine for fire detection. Free to audit with verified certificate available, includes 1-year ArcGIS Pro license.

    [University of Idaho Fire Ecology Certificate](https://www.uidaho.edu/cnr/natural-resources-online/fem-tech){target=_blank} - Online Certificate in Fire Ecology, Management and Technology covering fire science writing, fuels management, GIS applications, smoke and air quality, and fire policy. Feeds into Master of Natural Resources degree.

    [NC State Forestry and Environmental Resources](https://cnr.ncsu.edu/fer/){target=_blank} - Online graduate courses covering southeastern fire ecology and prescribed fire planning through College of Natural Resources.

    [UBC Okanagan Wildland Fire Ecology Micro-credential](https://cpe.ok.ubc.ca/programs/wildland-fire-ecology-and-management/){target=_blank} - Micro-credential in Wildland Fire Ecology, 30 hours per course, offered January and September.

??? Tip "Professional Training Platforms"

    [FireRescue1 Academy](https://www.firerescue1.com/academy/){target=_blank} (Lexipol Training) - 350+ fire courses with subscription-based access for departments. Covers structural and wildland operations.

    [IAFC Academy](https://www.iafc.org/education){target=_blank} (International Association of Fire Chiefs) - Propane emergency response, hazmat training, and leadership development.

    [CFITrainer.Net](https://www.cfitrainer.net/){target=_blank} - Online fire investigation modules including "Wildfires 1" (burn patterns) and "Wildfires 2" (lightning investigation).

??? Tip "Regulatory Compliance Training"

    [Oregon OSHA Wildfire Smoke Safety](https://osha.oregon.gov/edu/courses/Pages/wildfire-smoke-course.aspx){target=_blank} - Free online wildfire smoke safety course meeting state regulatory requirements for worker protection.

    [California OSHA Wildfire Smoke](https://www.dir.ca.gov/dosh/wildfire/){target=_blank} - Free online wildfire smoke safety course meeting Cal/OSHA requirements for employee training.

??? Tip "Professional Society Webinars"

    [Northern Rockies Fire Science Network](https://www.nrfirescience.org/){target=_blank} - Archive of 400+ recorded webinars on fire science research and management.

    [California Fire Science Consortium](https://www.cafirescience.org/){target=_blank} - Weekly seminar series (February-March) connecting researchers with practitioners.

    [International Association of Wildland Fire](https://www.iawfonline.org/){target=_blank} - Conference recordings and webinars on fire ecology, management, and policy.

    [Society of American Foresters](https://www.eforester.org/){target=_blank} - ForestEd online platform providing Continuing Forestry Education credits.

## 9. :octicons-gear-24: Specialized Training

For specialists pursuing advanced skills in specific fire disciplines.

??? Tip "Fire Ecology Field Courses"

    [University of Colorado Boulder Mountain Research Station](https://www.colorado.edu/mrs/research/fire-ecology){target=_blank} - 2-week Forest & Fire Ecology course (3 credits, $2,100) covering tree ring fire history reconstruction and GIS analysis.

    [University of Montana Prescribed Fire Training](http://www.cfc.umt.edu/undergrad/firesciences/practicum.php){target=_blank} - 2-week January prescribed fire training in Southeast with The Nature Conservancy in longleaf pine ecosystems.

    [USFS Fire Ecology Curriculum](https://www.fs.usda.gov/r03/educational/educators/fire-ecology-learning-lab){target=_blank} - Southwestern Region ecological foundations.

    [The Open University: Fire Ecology Course (free)](https://www.open.edu/openlearn/science-maths-technology/fire-ecology/content-section-0){target=_blank} - Open access fire ecology fundamentals.

??? Tip "Wildland-Urban Interface (WUI)"

    [National Volunteer Fire Council WFAP](https://www.nvfc.org/programs/wildland-fire-assessment-program/){target=_blank} - Volunteer home assessment training (4 online modules plus hands-on components).

    [UL Fire Safety Research Institute WUI Training](https://fsri.org/research-update/structure-triage){target=_blank} - Free Structure Triage Considerations for WUI Firefighting, incorporating analysis from Maui wildfire.

    **CSU San Marcos** - Online B.S. in Wildfire Science and Wildland-Urban Interface (see University Programs section).

    **International Code Council IWUIC Training** - International Wildland-Urban Interface Code training (see Professional Certifications section).

??? Tip "Smoke Management & Air Quality"

    [Interagency Wildland Fire Air Quality Response Program](https://wildlandfiresmoke.net/){target=_blank} - Air Resource Advisor certification through 5-day intensive training (June 23-27, 2025 session scheduled).

    **Oregon OSHA and California OSHA** - Free online smoke safety courses (see Online Learning section).

??? Tip "Fire Modeling & Decision Support"

    [WFM RD&A Mentee Program](https://www.fs.usda.gov/about-agency/fhm/wfm/mentee-program){target=_blank} - Skills development with FSPro, FlamMap, FARSITE, FireFamilyPlus, and WFDSS decision support tools through mentorship and detail assignments.

    Note: No formal FARSITE/FlamMap courses exist; training typically occurs through local unit channels and peer mentorship.

??? Tip "Fire Investigation"

    [FI-210 Wildland Fire Origin and Cause Determination](https://www.nwcg.gov/training/training-catalog){target=_blank} (NWCG) - Taught at Northern California Training Center in Redding and other locations.

    [CFITrainer.Net](https://www.cfitrainer.net/){target=_blank} - Online modules for wildfire investigation (see Online Learning section).

    Professional certifications available through IAAI, NAFI, and CCAI (see Professional Certifications section).

??? Tip "Aviation Operations"

    [USFS Smokejumper Rookie Training](https://www.fs.usda.gov/science-technology/fire/people/smokejumpers){target=_blank} - 5-week intensive program at bases in Missoula, McCall, Redding, and seven other locations.

    Prerequisites: 3-4 years fire experience (hotshot preferred), 7 pull-ups, 45 sit-ups, 25 push-ups, 1.5-mile run under 11 minutes, 110-lb pack test.

    [BLM Idaho Boise Helitack](https://www.nifc.gov/about-us/our-partners/blm/blm-helitack-crews){target=_blank} - Operates the only DOI Type 1 helicopter (UH-60 Blackhawk), providing specialized aviation training opportunities.

## 10. :octicons-organization-16: Nonprofit & NGO Programs

Hands-on training programs from nonprofit organizations emphasizing field experience.

??? Tip "The Nature Conservancy Fire Programs"

    [TREX (Prescribed Fire Training Exchanges)](https://www.nature.org/en-us/what-we-do/our-priorities/protect-water-and-land/land-and-water-stories/fire-training-exchanges-expand-controlled-burns/){target=_blank} - 150+ events since 2009, 4,300+ participants, 175,000+ acres treated. Provides NWCG taskbook training for Squad Boss, Engine Boss, Burn Boss, Public Information Officer, and Fire Effects Monitor positions.

    [Fire Learning Network](https://www.conservationgateway.org/ConservationPractices/FireLandscapes/FireLearningNetwork/Pages/fire-learning-network.aspx){target=_blank} - 47 landscapes nationwide since 2002 in cooperation with federal agencies, promoting landscape-scale prescribed fire.

    **Indigenous Peoples Burning Network** - Founded 2015, supports 26+ tribes (see Tribal & Indigenous Fire Programs section).

??? Tip "Tall Timbers Research Station"

    [Tall Timbers Fire Training](https://talltimbers.org/fire-training/){target=_blank} - NWCG-sanctioned courses including S-131 (Firefighter Type 1) and RX-300 (Introduction to Prescribed Fire).

    Department of Defense civilian fire training programs.

    **National Interagency Prescribed Fire Training Center** (since 2021) - Housed at Tall Timbers, providing multi-agency prescribed fire training.

    **Southern Fire Exchange** headquarters - Regional fire science translation serving 11 southeastern states.

??? Tip "Wildland Fire Lessons Learned Center"

    [Wildland Fire Lessons Learned Center](https://lessons.fs2c.usda.gov/){target=_blank} - Case studies, after-action reviews, safety resources, and analysis of significant fire events.

??? Tip "Conservation Corps & Youth Programs"

    **Student Conservation Association Wildland Fire Academy** - 6-month paid positions on Shasta-Trinity National Forest (see Getting Started section).

    **Veterans Fire Corps** - Conservation Legacy/SCA/AmeriCorps programs (see Getting Started section).

    **California Conservation Corps** - 26+ hand crews at 13 locations (see Getting Started section).

??? Tip "Community Protection Programs"

    [NFPA Firewise USA](https://www.nfpa.org/education-and-research/wildfire/firewise-usa){target=_blank} - Nearly 3,000 recognized community sites nationwide implementing wildfire protection measures.

    **NFPA Certified Wildfire Mitigation Specialist** - Professional credential (see Professional Certifications section).

    **IBHS Wildfire Prepared Home** - Free online learning (see Professional Certifications section).

## 11. :material-leaf: Traditional Ecological Knowledge

For researchers, land managers, and Indigenous communities integrating traditional knowledge with fire science.

[:material-leaf: US NPS Overview of TEK](https://www.nps.gov/subjects/tek/description.htm){target=_blank} - National Park Service introduction to Traditional Ecological Knowledge in land management and fire stewardship.

[:material-leaf: Yale Environment 360 - Overview](https://e360.yale.edu/features/native-knowledge-what-ecologists-are-learning-from-indigenous-people){target=_blank} - What ecologists are learning from Indigenous people about fire ecology and traditional burning practices.

[Global Indigenous Data Alliance](https://www.gida-global.org/care){target=_blank} - CARE principles for Indigenous Data Governance: Collective benefit, Authority to control, Responsibility, and Ethics. Essential framework for respectful engagement with Indigenous knowledge systems.

**Related Programs**: See Section 7 (Tribal & Indigenous Fire Programs) for:
- Indigenous Peoples Burning Network
- Intertribal Timber Council
- BIA training programs
- Lane Community College and UBC Okanagan programs with Indigenous focus

## 12. :fontawesome-solid-house-laptop: General Data Science Skills

For fire scientists needing computational and data analysis skills.

Explore these resources for gaining essential data science skills applicable to fire science research and analysis.

[:material-hammer: Carpentries](https://carpentries.org/){target=_blank} - Basic data science skills including programming, version control, and reproducible research.

[:octicons-mortar-board-24: CyVerse Learning](https://learning.cyverse.org){target=_blank} - Life science data science skills with applications to ecological research.

[:material-forest: The Dendro Hub](https://www.dendrohub.com/){target=_blank} - Online community for current and aspiring dendrochronologists from around the world, supporting fire history research.

[:material-earth: Earth Lab (CU Boulder)](https://earthdatascience.org/){target=_blank} - Earth science data science skills including remote sensing and geospatial analysis.

[:material-chat-outline: JoVE](https://www.jove.com/){target=_blank} - Videos of science protocols, including [fire history reconstruction](https://www.jove.com/t/61698/using-tree-rings-to-reconstruct-fire-history-information-from){target=_blank} from tree rings.

[:fontawesome-solid-syringe: Protocols.io](https://www.protocols.io/){target=_blank} - Standardized methods and protocols for scientific research.

[WholeTale](https://wholetale.org/){target=_blank} - Create and publish transparent and reproducible research workflows.

## USFS Brand Standards Preview
URL: https://tyson-swetnam.github.io/awesome-fire-science/usfs-brand-preview.md

# USFS Brand Standards Preview

This page demonstrates the updated design elements based on U.S. Forest Service brand standards.

## Typography Hierarchy

### Primary Heading (H1)
Uses Merriweather - a professional serif font with authority and readability.

#### Secondary Heading (H2)
Clean hierarchy with Forest Service blue accent border.

##### Tertiary Heading (H3)
Forest Service green for subsections.

###### Category Heading (H4)
UPPERCASE UTILITY HEADING FOR CATEGORIES

Body text uses **Public Sans** - a professional, accessible sans-serif font developed for government use. It provides excellent readability and a modern, clean appearance suitable for both digital and print materials.

## Color Palette

The design implements official USFS colors:

!!! note "USFS Green - PANTONE 343 CV"
    Primary brand color: `#00502F` - Deep forest green representing the natural environment and Forest Service heritage.

!!! info "USFS Blue - PANTONE 288 CV"
    Secondary color: `#004B87` - Professional blue for accents and interactive elements.

!!! tip "Professional Application"
    These colors create a cohesive, authoritative appearance while maintaining accessibility standards (WCAG AA compliance).

## Content Blocks

### Admonition Styles

??? tip "Forest Service Green Tips"
    Tips and best practices use the primary USFS green color scheme. This creates visual consistency with the Forest Service brand identity.

    Key features:
    - Left border accent
    - Gradient background
    - Professional typography

!!! warning "Fire Weather Warning"
    Warnings use fire orange tones to convey urgency and attention. This is particularly relevant for fire science content.

!!! danger "Critical Alert"
    Critical information uses alert red for maximum visibility and immediate attention.

!!! note "Standard Information"
    Standard notes use the USFS blue color for neutral information and guidance.

## Links & Navigation

[Internal Link Example](#typography-hierarchy) - Links use USFS blue with hover states.

[External Link Example](https://www.fs.usda.gov){target=_blank} - External links include indicator arrow.

### Button Styles

<div class="md-button">USFS Green Button</div>
<div class="md-button md-button--primary">USFS Blue Button</div>

## Data Tables

|----------|-------------|--------|

## Code Presentation

```python
# Fire behavior calculation example
def calculate_rate_of_spread(wind_speed, slope, fuel_moisture):
    """
    Calculate fire rate of spread using simplified model.
    Based on USFS fire behavior prediction systems.
    """
    base_ros = 2.5  # chains per hour
    wind_factor = wind_speed * 0.3
    slope_factor = slope * 0.15
    moisture_factor = (100 - fuel_moisture) / 100

    return base_ros * (1 + wind_factor + slope_factor) * moisture_factor
```

Inline code examples use `monospace typography` with subtle backgrounds.

## Design Principles

The updated design follows these USFS brand principles:

1. **Authority & Trust**: Professional typography and official colors establish credibility
2. **Accessibility**: High contrast ratios and clear hierarchy ensure usability
3. **Natural Elements**: Subtle textures and organic color palette connect to forestry
4. **Federal Identity**: Consistent with U.S. government design standards
5. **Professionalism**: Clean layouts with appropriate spacing and refinement

## Responsive Behavior

The design adapts seamlessly across devices:

- **Desktop**: Full navigation, wide content areas, detailed typography
- **Tablet**: Responsive grids, touch-friendly targets
- **Mobile**: Streamlined navigation, optimized text size, vertical stacking

## Dark Mode

Toggle to dark mode to see the adapted color scheme:

- Forest Service green remains prominent but lighter for contrast
- Blue accents shift to lighter tones for visibility
- Backgrounds use deep grays with subtle green tints
- Code blocks maintain readability with adjusted colors

---

**Note**: This preview demonstrates the comprehensive CSS overhaul implementing USFS FS-1186 brand standards (May 2023), including official color palette, professional typography, and federal design system best practices.
